newsitem.title: USA: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to watch - July 16.
newsitem.headline: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to watch - July 16.

text.p: -- Intel Corp reported a 58 percent rise in second-quarter profits, earning $1.6 billion or $0.92 per share. The First Call consensus estimate was $0.90 per share. Revenues rose to $6.0 billion from $4.6 billion a year ago. The stock closed at 80-29/32, then rose to 83 in after-hours trading.

-- Ascend Communications Inc reported net income of $0.31 per share for the second quarter, slightly below the Wall Street consensus estimate of $0.35. Excluding the cost of acquiring Cascade Communications Corp and Whitetree Inc, the company's net income rose 40 percent from a year earlier. The stock closed at 53-7/8, then dipped to 52 after the close.

-- The pact British Telecommunications Plc signed to buy MCI Communications Corp rules out using the performance of MCI's local phone business as a "materially adverse" event that could trigger renegotiation, the Wall Street Journal reported. MCI's stock finished at 35-15/16.
-- Pfizer Inc posted second quarter earnings of $0.35 per share, compared to $0.31 a year ago. Revenues were $2.91 billion, up from $2.66 billion. The stock closed at 61-11/16.
-- Amgen reported second quarter earnings of $0.72 per share, versus $0.64 in the year-ago quarter. The stock closed at 57-1/4.
